_comment: vendors: Tripo generation log for the three town merchants (Eric: log every attempt, the defects and the credits). Pipeline per merchant: ChatGPT turnaround sheet (Art/Vendors/cts_vendor_<id>_ref*.png) -> Tools/ProcessVendorArt.py --views crops (front / right / back, plus left on 4-view sheets) -> Tripo Studio HD Model, multi-view, H3.1 Best Quality, Ultra Mesh, 8K PBR, Remove Lighting, Quad 50k (70 credits) -> 4-VIEW CHECK before rigging (Tools/RunVendorGallery.py --meshes: front/right/back/left + face + back of head: one face, palms and thumbs the right way, no mirrored or fused parts) -> Humanoid auto-rig on the UE5 Mannequin preset (20 credits) -> free presets idle, greet_01, agree, look_around -> Studio Export (FBX, Blender preset, 4K, all clips) named CTS_Vendor_<Folder> -> unzip to Saved/TripoExports/<Folder> -> Tools/ImportVendorFbx.py (see _transfer) -> SECOND CHECK after rigging (Tools/RunVendorGallery.py: idle + greet with both hands from the front and each hand from its side: no wrist twist, inverted hands, tearing or backward fingers). Retry rule (Eric 2026-09-26): up to 2 retries (3 attempts); if none passes, ship the best and record its remaining defects; a Janus face or backwards hands on the best attempt is flagged to Eric.

_transfer: The DCC Bridge 'Send To Unreal' could not be driven reliably (the Studio page only sends once the Unreal toggle in the DCC Bridge popover is on, and even then nothing arrived); the bodies came in through Studio 'Export' (FBX, Blender preset, 4K, all four clips) -> Saved/TripoExports/<Folder> (not committed) -> Tools/ImportVendorFbx.py (commandlet) into /Game/Tripo/Vendors/<Folder>, clips tidied to CTS_Vendor_<Folder>_<clip>. The pre-rig check imports the unrigged export as a static mesh under /Game/Tripo/VendorChecks (not committed).
_textures: Imported textures: no mips, never streamed (Tripo atlases have no island padding); the Tripo normal map is rendered at weight 0 on the FBX legacy-Phong instance because it does not match the FBX tangent frame (sharp dark patches along UV islands on the faces, either green convention).
